summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of Taskly (localStorage-only). All 11 requested functional and UI scenarios tested at desktop (1920) and mobile (390) — all passed. No backend involved.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: setPriority resets to 'Medium' after every add, which matches the spec (default Medium) but users may expect the last-selected priority to persist for rapid entry — worth confirming with product.
Minor: crypto.randomUUID fallback correctly handles older environments — good defensive coding.
Nit: PRIORITY_STYLES class strings are safe because they are static keys (Low/Medium/High), not dynamic Tailwind classes — no purge concerns.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure frontend localStorage app (key 'taskly_tasks_v1'). No backend. All data-testids listed in the request are present and working: taskly-header, task-input, priority-select (native <select>, use select_option), add-task-button, filter-tab-{all,active,completed}, task-item, task-checkbox, task-title, task-priority, task-delete-button, active-task-counter, empty-state. Verified: add/trim/empty-reject, complete/uncomplete + strikethrough + sort-to-bottom, delete + localStorage removal, filter tabs non-destructive, refresh persistence, empty states for all three modes, priority badge colors (emerald/amber/rose), no horizontal overflow at 390px with a long title.
